error.connection_failed: Failed to connect to remote machine

role.panel_pc_no_agent: This computer is used as the management panel; the PC agent is not installed here.
role.agent_on_panel_pc: The PC agent is installed on this computer; the agent must not run on the main machine.

warn.unpaired: This PC no longer trusts the panel

list.title: PCs
list.rename_hint: Only this panel shows the new name. Leave it empty to use the PC's own name ({name}).
list.unpair_body: {name} will be forgotten here and on that PC. To connect again you need a new pairing code.
list.unavailable_hint: Can't connect to an offline PC

empty.title: No PCs added yet
empty.body: On the PC you want to watch, open the Desk-Remote Agent and enter the code it shows here.

none.title: No matching PCs
none.body: Try changing the search or the filter.

err.title: Couldn't load the list
err.body: The PC list couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

pair.title: Add PC

code.label: Code shown on the PC
code.hint: 8 characters. The code is valid for 5 minutes and works once.

target.label: PC address
target.hint: Pick a PC found on your network or Tailscale below, or type its IP address or name.
target.none: No PCs found yet. Type the address instead.

name.label: PC name (optional)
name.hint: If left empty, the PC's own name is used.

step1.title: Open the agent on the PC
step1.body: Start the Desk-Remote Agent on the remote PC.

step2.title: Show the code
step2.body: Click “Show pairing code” in the agent; an 8-character code appears.

step3.title: Enter it here
step3.body: Type or paste the code in the field on the left.

invalid.title: Invalid code
invalid.detail: Check the code. Enter letters and digits exactly as shown on the PC.

expired.title: The code has expired
expired.detail: Click “Show new code” on the PC and enter the new one.

used.title: This code was already used
used.detail: Each code works once. Generate a new one on the PC.

network.title: Couldn't reach the PC
network.detail: Check your connection (local network or Tailscale) and try again.

rejected.title: The PC refused the code
rejected.detail: The code is wrong, expired or already used. Click “Show new code” on the PC and try again.

unpaired.title: Not paired
unpaired.detail: This PC does not trust this panel. Pair it again with a new code.

target.title: Address missing
target.detail: Pick a PC from the list or type its IP address or name.

ok.title: PC paired
ok.body: {name} is now in your list. You can connect right away.

pair.demo: Demo backend: ABCD-2345 succeeds · EXPR-0000 expired · USED-1111 already used · NETW-0000 network error · anything else is invalid

mode.control_hint: Mouse and keyboard go to the remote PC

toast.control: Control on — mouse and keyboard now go to the remote PC

screen_unavailable.title: Screen is currently unavailable
screen_unavailable.body: Remote desktop helper is not connected or screen capture is unavailable. The screen will resume once the helper is ready.

lost.title: Connection lost
lost.fail_body: {name} didn't respond after {max} attempts. The PC may be off or disconnected from the network.
lost.unpaired_body: {name} no longer trusts this panel, or its key changed. Pair it again with a new code on the PC.

unsupported.title: This system can't decode H.264
unsupported.body: The WebView does not provide hardware or software H.264 decoding.

idle.title: Closed because nothing happened
idle.body: The connection to {name} was closed after a long time without any activity. Connect again whenever you like.

idle_warn.text: This connection closes in 1 minute because it is idle.
idle_warn.background: {name} closes in 1 minute because it is idle.

ended.title: {name} ended the session
ended.body: The person at that PC disconnected you.

denied.title: {name} refused the connection
denied.body: The person at that PC declined the request. You can try again.

noanswer.title: {name} didn't answer
noanswer.body: Nobody accepted the request in time. Ask them to check the screen, then try again.

hostviewonly.tip: The person at {name} allows watching only; input is off.

palette.title: Palette
palette.hint: Pick a color family. It applies immediately.

tailscale.title: Connection
tailscale.hint: The panel reaches PCs on your local network, or anywhere through your tailnet, with its own built-in connection. No Tailscale app and no server of your own are needed.
tailscale.connecting: Waiting for sign-in in your browser…
tailscale.connect_hint: A sign-in page opens in your browser. Once you finish, this status turns to connected. The panel uses its own connection and never changes the Tailscale app, if you have one.
tailscale.disconnect_hint: Signs only this panel out of your tailnet. Another Tailscale app on this PC is not affected.
tailscale.failed: Couldn't start the sign-in. Try again.

idle.title: Close idle connections
idle.hint: A connection with no mouse, keyboard or file activity closes by itself after this time. You get a warning one minute before. Each PC is counted separately; only watching counts as idle.
idle.label: Idle time before a connection closes

tray.balloon_body: A paired device is watching this PC.
tray.code_hint: Type this code in the Desk-Remote panel.
tray.tailnet_needs_admin: Administrator permission required for Tailscale takeover
tray.update_installing: Installing {v}. The agent restarts in a moment.
tray.update_deferred: {v} is ready and installs as soon as nobody is viewing this PC.
tray.update_failed: The update check failed. Nothing was changed on this PC.
tray.paired_remove_body: Remove the pairing of {name}? It can no longer connect to this PC until it is paired again with a new code.
tray.peer_file_title: A paired panel sent a file
tray.login_body: Right-click the Desk-Remote tray icon and choose “Sign in to Tailscale”. You only need to do this once.

about.title: About Desk-Remote
about.hint: Compare these with what the panel shows when pairing.

incoming.title: Connections to this PC
incoming.sub: Let other devices running Desk-Remote connect to this PC.
incoming.unavailable: This build can't accept connections yet.
incoming.off_hint: If you turn this on, other devices can connect to this PC while the app is open.
incoming.on_hint: Other devices can ask to connect while Desk-Remote is open. You approve every request.

live.hint: You can end it from the bar at the top.

code.title: Connection code
code.hint: Enter this code on the other device. Each code works once.

addr.title: Addresses
addr.sub: The other device can also connect to one of these addresses.

dialog.title: {name} wants to connect to this PC
dialog.body: Whoever you allow can see your screen. Only accept devices you know.
dialog.countdown: No answer in {s} s counts as Reject.

transfer.unavailable: File sending isn't in this build yet.

pick.title: Send to which PC?
pick.choose_pc: Choose a PC to enable Send.
pick.nothing: None of these can be sent.
pick.too_large: Too large — at most {mb} MB can be sent.
pick.folder: Folders can't be sent. Pick files instead.
pick.network: Network paths can't be sent. Copy the file to this PC first.

err.too_large: File is larger than the limit.
err.denied: The other PC refused the file.
err.busy: The other PC is busy with another transfer.
err.disk_full: Not enough disk space on the other PC.
err.unsupported_folder: Folders can't be sent. Pick files instead.
err.hash_mismatch: The file arrived damaged (checksum mismatch). Try again.
err.cancelled_by_peer: The other PC canceled the transfer.
err.network: The connection to the other PC was lost. Try again.
err.read_failed: The file couldn't be read on this PC.
err.timeout: The other PC didn't confirm the file in time.
err.unpaired: This PC is no longer paired. Pair it again.

offer.title: {name} wants to send you a file
offer.body: Nothing is saved until you accept. Only accept files you expect.
offer.countdown: No answer in {s} s counts as Reject.

set.title: File transfer
set.hint: Limits what this PC will send and receive.
set.limit_hint: Between 1 and 1024. Larger files are refused on both ends.
set.limit_bad: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1024.
set.menu_hint: Adds “Send with Desk-Remote” when you right-click a file.
set.menu_unavailable: The right-click menu isn't in this build yet.

installer.service_install: Registering and starting the Desk-Remote agent service…
installer.service_remove: Stopping and removing the Desk-Remote agent service…
installer.service_failed: The agent service could not be installed. The installation was cancelled and nothing was kept.
installer.menu_register: Adding the Explorer entry "Send with Desk-Remote"…
installer.menu_remove: Removing the Explorer entry "Send with Desk-Remote"…
installer.update_restored: The update failed. The previous version was restored and keeps running.

upd.title: Panel updates
upd.hint: Desk-Remote looks for a new version on GitHub. Only this panel is updated; every PC updates its own agent.

state.waiting: Ready — waits until your connections end

upd.auto_hint: When on, the panel looks for a new version every time it opens and installs it. An open remote connection is never interrupted.
upd.failed_hint: Nothing was changed on this PC. Check the internet connection and try again.
